Our residential roofing services provide lasting protection and enhance your home’s appearance. From repairs and full roof replacements to new installations, we use only the highest quality materials and skilled craftsmanship.

Our Mission

At AZ Roof Pros, we aim to transform the roofing industry by establishing new benchmarks for quality, innovation, and customer service. Utilizing cutting-edge technology and outstanding craftsmanship, we build durable, attractive roofs that provide lasting protection and elevate the beauty of every property. Our steadfast dedication to quality and customer satisfaction drives us to innovate consistently, delivering exceptional results that surpass our clients’ expectations. We prioritize empowering our team to thrive alongside our success, cultivating a culture of collaboration, professional growth, and pride in every project we handle.

Our Process

Consultation

We start with a comprehensive consultation to assess your needs and provide an accurate estimate.

  • Roof inspection
  • Explore options
  • Provide a detailed estimate
Step 1

Planning

We develop a tailored plan, choose materials, and schedule the project.

- Customized plan
- Material selection
- Scheduling of labor and materials

Step 2

Installation

Our team installs your roof with expertise and attention to detail.

  • Project manager oversight
  • On-site foreman
  • Adherence to safety standards
Step 3

Inspection & Follow Up

We conduct a thorough inspection of the work, answer any questions, and confirm your satisfaction.

  • Final inspection
  • Confirm satisfaction
  • Final payment
Step 4

Finance and Insurance Claim Options

Financing

We provide flexible financing options to make your roofing project more affordable. Our plans include deferred payment options for up to 12 months, allowing you to get the roof you need without financial stress.

Learn More

Insurance Assistance

Dealing with insurance claims can be complicated. Our experts offer straightforward assistance to help you secure the coverage you deserve, using a tailored approach to expedite your roof installation.
